name: What are the first steps to plan a complete home renovation?

mainEntity.name: What are the first steps to plan a complete home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The first steps to plan a complete home renovation involve defining your vision, setting a realistic budget, and researching design ideas. Consider what aspects of your home you want to change, what lifestyle improvements you seek, and what materials or finishes you prefer. This initial phase helps clarify your project goals. Hometelligent Inc. recommends gathering inspiration and prioritizing your needs before contacting a contractor. This preparation allows us to provide more accurate estimates and design recommendations tailored to your objectives and to streamline the design and planning phases, helping to avoid costly changes later.
